description: This classic New York Strip Steak with Garlic Butter is a testament to simple American elegance. Perfectly seared to a beautiful crust and basted with aromatic garlic herb butter, it promises a tender, juicy bite every time. A restaurant-quality meal made effortlessly in your own kitchen.

instructions.title: Prepare the Steaks
instructions.text: Remove steaks from the refrigerator 30-45 minutes before cooking to bring them to room temperature. Pat them very dry with paper towels. Season generously on all sides with kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper.

instructions.title: Heat the Skillet
instructions.text: Heat a heavy-bottomed skillet, preferably cast iron, over high heat until it begins to smoke lightly. Add the olive oil and swirl to coat the pan.

instructions.title: Sear the Steaks
instructions.text: Carefully place the seasoned steaks in the hot skillet. Sear for 2-3 minutes per side for a medium-rare steak, or longer for desired doneness, until a deep brown crust forms. Do not overcrowd the pan; cook in batches if necessary.

instructions.title: Add Garlic Butter
instructions.text: Reduce the heat to medium-low. Add the unsalted butter, minced garlic, rosemary, and thyme to the skillet. Allow the butter to melt and the aromatics to become fragrant, about 30 seconds.

instructions.title: Baste the Steaks
instructions.text: Tilt the pan slightly and use a large spoon to continuously baste the melted garlic herb butter over the steaks for 1-2 minutes. This infuses the steaks with incredible flavor and helps create an even crust.

instructions.title: Rest the Steaks
instructions.text: Remove the steaks from the skillet and transfer them to a cutting board. Tent loosely with aluminum foil and let them rest for at least 5-10 minutes. This allows the juices to redistribute, ensuring a tender and juicy steak.

instructions.title: Slice and Serve
instructions.text: Slice the rested steaks against the grain into thick pieces. Drizzle with any remaining garlic butter from the pan or from the resting board. Serve immediately with your favorite sides.

article:
Elevate your weeknight dinner or special occasion meal with a dish that embodies classic American comfort and sophisticated flavor: New York Strip Steak with Garlic Butter. This recipe transforms a quality cut of beef into a culinary masterpiece, bathed in aromatic, rich garlic butter that melts into every savory bite. It’s a truly unforgettable American dinner recipe that will have everyone asking for seconds.

## What is New York Strip Steak Garlic Butter?

New York Strip Steak Garlic Butter is a quintessential American dinner recipe that celebrates the robust flavor of a well-marbled New York strip steak, enhanced by a simple yet incredibly potent garlic herb butter. The New York strip, known for its tender texture and rich beefy taste, comes from the short loin of the cow, offering a perfect balance of leanness and fat marbling. When seared to a beautiful crust and then basted with a fragrant butter infused with fresh garlic and herbs like thyme or rosemary, it creates an unparalleled depth of flavor. This method not only adds moisture but also caramelizes the exterior, locking in juices and infusing the steak with an irresistible aroma. It’s a straightforward approach that yields restaurant-quality results right in your own kitchen, making it a beloved staple for steak enthusiasts.

## Ingredients You Need

To create this magnificent New York Strip Steak Garlic Butter, you'll need high-quality ingredients that allow the natural flavors to shine.

*   2 (10-12 ounce) New York strip steaks, about 1.5 inches thick
*   1 tablespoon olive oil (or other high smoke point oil like avocado oil)
*   1 teaspoon coarse sea salt
*   1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
*   6 tablespoons unsalted butter
*   4-6 cloves garlic, minced
*   2 sprigs fresh rosemary
*   2 sprigs fresh thyme
*   Optional Garnish: Fresh parsley, chopped

## Step-by-Step Instructions

Follow these steps carefully to achieve a perfectly cooked, incredibly flavorful New York Strip Steak Garlic Butter.

1.  **Prepare the Steaks:** Remove the New York strip steaks from the refrigerator about 30-60 minutes before cooking. Pat them thoroughly dry with paper towels. This is a crucial step for achieving a good sear. Season both sides generously with coarse sea salt and freshly ground black pepper.
2.  **Heat the Pan:** Place a heavy-bottomed skillet, preferably cast iron, over high heat. Allow it to preheat for 3-5 minutes until it is smoking hot. Add the olive oil to the hot pan and swirl to coat the bottom.
3.  **Sear the Steaks:** Carefully place the seasoned steaks into the hot skillet. Sear undisturbed for 2-3 minutes per side until a deep brown crust forms. Do not overcrowd the pan; cook one steak at a time if necessary.
4.  **Reduce Heat and Add Butter/Aromatics:** Once both sides are seared, reduce the heat to medium. Add the unsalted butter, minced garlic, fresh rosemary, and fresh thyme to the pan. The butter should melt and foam around the steaks.
5.  **Baste the Steaks:** As the butter melts, tilt the pan slightly and use a large spoon to continuously baste the melted garlic herb butter over the steaks. Spoon the butter over the steaks for 2-4 minutes, flipping occasionally, until they reach your desired doneness.
    *   For Rare (125-130°F): Approximately 2-3 minutes per side.
    *   For Medium-Rare (130-135°F): Approximately 3-4 minutes per side.
    *   For Medium (135-140°F): Approximately 4-5 minutes per side.
    *   Always use an instant-read thermometer for accuracy.
6.  **Rest the Steaks:** Once the steaks reach your desired internal temperature, remove them from the pan and place them on a cutting board or plate. Tent loosely with foil and let them rest for at least 5-10 minutes. This allows the juices to redistribute throughout the meat, ensuring a tender and juicy steak.
7.  **Serve:** Slice the steaks against the grain into thick pieces. Drizzle any remaining garlic butter from the pan over the sliced steak. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired, and serve immediately.

## Pro Tips for the Best Results

Achieving the perfect New York Strip Steak Garlic Butter is all about attention to detail. Here are some expert tips:

*   **Room Temperature Steaks:** Always bring your steaks to room temperature before cooking. Cold steaks will cook unevenly, resulting in a less tender interior.
*   **Pat Dry:** This cannot be stressed enough. Moisture on the surface of the steak prevents a good sear, leading to a steamed rather than crispy crust. Use plenty of paper towels.
*   **Hot Pan, Hot Oil:** A screaming hot pan is essential for developing that beautiful, flavorful crust (Maillard reaction). Don't be afraid to let your pan get very hot before adding the oil and then the steak.
*   **Don't Overcrowd:** If cooking multiple steaks, do them one at a time or in batches to avoid dropping the pan temperature, which again, hinders searing.
*   **Use Fresh Herbs:** While dried herbs can work in a pinch, fresh rosemary and thyme release much more aromatic oils and flavor into the butter, significantly enhancing the New York Strip Steak Garlic Butter.
*   **Basting is Key:** Continuous basting with the garlic butter not only imparts incredible flavor but also helps to cook the steak evenly and keep it moist.
*   **Resting is Non-Negotiable:** After all that effort, don't skip the resting step! It's vital for a juicy steak. Cutting into it too soon will cause all the delicious juices to run out.
*   **Use a Thermometer:** Visual cues can be misleading. An instant-read meat thermometer is your best friend for hitting the perfect doneness every time.

## Serving Suggestions

The rich flavor of New York Strip Steak Garlic Butter pairs wonderfully with a variety of side dishes, making for a truly satisfying American dinner recipe.

*   **Potatoes:** Classic choices include creamy mashed potatoes, crispy roasted potatoes, or a simple baked potato with sour cream and chives. The garlic butter from the steak can even be drizzled over the potatoes for extra flavor.
*   **Vegetables:** Complement the richness of the steak with fresh, vibrant vegetables. Asparagus spears, green beans almondine, creamed spinach, or roasted broccoli are excellent choices. A simple side salad with a light vinaigrette also provides a nice contrast.
*   **Bread:** A crusty baguette or garlic bread is perfect for soaking up any leftover garlic butter and steak juices.
*   **Wine Pairing:** For a beverage, a bold red wine like Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, or Zinfandel will stand up beautifully to the robust flavors of the steak.

## Variations and Substitutions

While the classic New York Strip Steak Garlic Butter is perfect as is, you can certainly experiment with variations to suit your taste or dietary needs.

*   **Herb Variations:** Instead of rosemary and thyme, try fresh oregano, sage, or a pinch of red pepper flakes for a little heat.
*   **Spice Rubs:** Before searing, consider applying a dry rub with ingredients like paprika, onion powder, and a touch of cayenne for an extra layer of flavor.
*   **Compound Butter:** Prepare the garlic herb butter in advance by mixing softened butter with minced garlic and herbs, then rolling it into a log and chilling. Slice off pats to melt over the hot steak at the end.
*   **Cooking Method:** While pan-searing and basting is ideal, you can also finish the steak in the oven after searing, or even cook it entirely on the grill. If grilling, melt the garlic butter separately and brush it on the steak as it rests.
*   **Different Steaks:** While New York Strip is fantastic, this garlic butter technique works beautifully with other cuts like ribeye, sirloin, or even leaner cuts like flank steak (though cooking times will vary).
*   **Dairy-Free Option:** For a dairy-free version, use a high-quality plant-based butter alternative. The flavor profile will still be delicious.

Mastering the New York Strip Steak Garlic Butter is a culinary achievement that brings gourmet dining into your home. With its rich, savory flavors and juicy texture, it’s a timeless American dinner recipe that promises to impress and satisfy every time. Enjoy the process, savor the aroma, and delight in every mouth-watering bite!
